package tlscache

import (
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/x509"
	"crypto/x509/pkix"
	"encoding/asn1"
	"errors"
	"math/big"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func certificate(t *testing.T, serial int64, padding int) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	key := ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(make([]byte, 32))
	cert := &x509.Certificate{SerialNumber: big.NewInt(serial),
		Subject:   pkix.Name{CommonName: "cache-reference.invalid"},
		NotBefore: time.Unix(0, 0), NotAfter: time.Unix(2000000000, 0),
		DNSNames: []string{"cache-reference.invalid"},
		KeyUsage: x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature}
	if padding > 0 {
		cert.ExtraExtensions = []pkix.Extension{{Id: asn1.ObjectIdentifier{1, 2, 3, 4}, Value: make([]byte, padding)}}
	}
	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, cert, cert, key.Public(), key)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return der
}
func exactCertificate(t *testing.T, serial int64, size int) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	padding := size - 512
	for range 5 {
		der := certificate(t, serial, padding)
		if len(der) == size {
			return der
		}
		padding += size - len(der)
	}
	t.Fatal("cannot construct exact public certificate size")
	return nil
}
func TestCacheRetainsIdentityThroughGC(t *testing.T) {
	cache := new(weakCertCache)
	der := certificate(t, 1, 0)
	first, err := cache.newCert(der)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	runtime.GC()
	again, err := cache.newCert(append([]byte(nil), der...))
	if err != nil || first != again || cache.used != 1 || cache.derSize != len(der) {
		t.Fatal("retained certificate identity or charge changed")
	}
}
func TestCacheRejectsOversizedDERBeforeParseOrCopy(t *testing.T) {
	cache := new(weakCertCache)
	der := make([]byte, lsfCertCacheMaximumDER+1)
	var err error
	allocs := testing.AllocsPerRun(100, func() { _, err = cache.newCert(der) })
	if err != lsfCertCacheExhausted || allocs != 0 || cache.used != 0 || cache.derSize != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("oversize admission allocated or parsed: allocations=%v", allocs)
	}
}
func TestCacheRejectsNinthDistinctCertificateAndRetainsHits(t *testing.T) {
	cache := new(weakCertCache)
	der := certificate(t, 1, 0)
	first, err := cache.newCert(der)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i := 2; i <= 8; i++ {
		if _, err := cache.newCert(certificate(t, int64(i), 0)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	before := cache.derSize
	if _, err := cache.newCert(certificate(t, 9, 0)); err != lsfCertCacheExhausted {
		t.Fatal("ninth certificate admitted")
	}
	got, err := cache.newCert(der)
	if err != nil || got != first || cache.used != 8 || cache.derSize != before {
		t.Fatal("full cache lost hit/charge")
	}
}
func TestCacheAggregateDERBudgetAndNoEviction(t *testing.T) {
	cache := new(weakCertCache)
	var first []byte
	for i := 1; i <= 4; i++ {
		der := exactCertificate(t, int64(i), lsfCertCacheMaximumDER)
		if i == 1 {
			first = der
		}
		if _, err := cache.newCert(der); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if cache.derSize != 65536 || cache.used != 4 {
		t.Fatal("aggregate bound did not reach exact boundary")
	}
	runtime.GC()
	if _, err := cache.newCert(certificate(t, 5, 0)); err != lsfCertCacheExhausted {
		t.Fatal("aggregate overflow/eviction")
	}
	if _, err := cache.newCert(first); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("existing hit refused at aggregate bound")
	}
	if cache.used != 4 || cache.derSize != 65536 {
		t.Fatal("premature capacity refund")
	}
}
func TestCacheParseFailureMatchesUpstreamAndConsumesNoEntry(t *testing.T) {
	cache := new(weakCertCache)
	for _, der := range [][]byte{nil, {1}, {48, 2, 1}} {
		_, want := x509.ParseCertificate(der)
		_, got := cache.newCert(der)
		if want == nil || got == nil || want.Error() != got.Error() || errors.Is(got, lsfCertCacheExhausted) {
			t.Fatal("upstream parser error changed")
		}
	}
	if cache.used != 0 || cache.derSize != 0 {
		t.Fatal("parse failure charged a cache entry")
	}
	if _, err := cache.newCert(certificate(t, 1, 0)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func TestFreshCacheStartsEmpty(t *testing.T) {
	old := new(weakCertCache)
	der := certificate(t, 1, 0)
	first, err := old.newCert(der)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fresh := new(weakCertCache)
	if fresh.used != 0 || fresh.derSize != 0 {
		t.Fatal("fresh cache inherited state")
	}
	second, err := fresh.newCert(der)
	if err != nil || second == first || fresh.used != 1 || old.used != 1 {
		t.Fatal("fresh cache reused old object")
	}
}
func TestConcurrentSameCertificatePublishesOnce(t *testing.T) {
	cache := new(weakCertCache)
	der := certificate(t, 1, 0)
	var wait sync.WaitGroup
	results := make(chan *x509.Certificate, 16)
	for range 16 {
		wait.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wait.Done()
			value, err := cache.newCert(der)
			if err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
				return
			}
			results <- value
		}()
	}
	wait.Wait()
	close(results)
	var first *x509.Certificate
	count := 0
	for value := range results {
		count++
		if first == nil {
			first = value
		} else if value != first {
			t.Fatal("duplicate concurrent parse published")
		}
	}
	if count != 16 || cache.used != 1 || cache.derSize != len(der) {
		t.Fatal("concurrent reservation drift")
	}
}
func TestCacheExactPerDERBoundaryAndOneByteRefusal(t *testing.T) {
	cache := new(weakCertCache)
	if _, err := cache.newCert(exactCertificate(t, 1, 16384)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := cache.newCert(exactCertificate(t, 2, 16385)); err != lsfCertCacheExhausted {
		t.Fatal("per-DER cap drift")
	}
	if cache.used != 1 || cache.derSize != 16384 {
		t.Fatal("refused DER modified charge")
	}
}
